regions.region: full original page: Organic Chemistry Frontiers accepted-manuscript cover and journal cover art
regions.finding: The page is publisher cover/front matter. The colorful journal cover image depicts unrelated photochemical artwork and is presentation content, not an experiment, scheme, molecule set, or result from this paper. The page supplies only citation/DOI metadata.

unresolved: No current-paper chemical experiment occurs on the cover page.

regions.region: upper title, author block, abstract, and article metadata
regions.finding: Verified the source title 'Catalyst-Controlled Formal [4+1] Annulation of N-Vinyl Fluorenone Nitrones and Allenoates to Prepare Spirofluorenylpyrrolines' and the aggregate Gimeracil-catalyzed formal [4+1] annulation claim. The ESI/CCDC availability statement does not establish a workspace SI association.

regions.region: two-column Introduction and cited nitrone/allenoate discussion
regions.finding: Classified traditional nitrone/allenoate indole chemistry, Prathapan's spiroannulation, and Anderson's rearrangement/hydrolysis chemistry as prior literature, and the authors' [4+1] concept as the current general class. No cited external run was promoted to a present-paper experiment.

unresolved: Introduction structures are generic and do not define unique experiment-specific charges or yields.

regions.finding: Separated three cited prior strategies from the current generic [4+1] design. The proposed rearrangement/enolation/cyclization inset is a pathway concept, not an additional experimental row.

regions.region: right-column Table 1 reaction header, catalyst structures C1-C4, entries 1-16, and footnotes a-f
regions.finding: Recorded all sixteen optimization rows independently with shared 1a/2a charges and solvent volume, row-specific catalyst/solvent/temperature/time/yield, C1 loading overrides, entry-7 ee <5%, and bounded/zero results. Entry 16 is merged with the matching 3aa standard scope result on page 4.
Mapped catalyst, temperature, solvent, and loading discussion to the sixteen Table 1 rows without creating prose duplicates. Entry 1 retains both table <5% and prose 'not observed' wording.

unresolved: Table 1 omits workups, purifications, isolated masses, atmosphere, and numerical detection limits.
The exact row times for page-4 Table 2 scope products are only given as a 3–6 h caption range.

regions.region: left-column Table 2 reaction header, products 3aa-3la, caption, and continuation prose
regions.finding: Recorded twelve nitrone-scope outcomes; standard 3aa is the same 77% C1/DMF/80 °C experiment as Table 1 entry 16 and is merged. The remaining eleven products are separate rows, with 3ba/3la dr and 3la NOE context retained.

regions.region: right-column Table 3 reaction header, products 3ab-3an, caption, and scope prose
regions.finding: Recorded all thirteen allenoate-scope rows independently, including explicit 3af 0%/not observed, 3aj enol:ketone 5.6:1, 3am 1:1 dr, 3an 20:1 dr/NOESY assignment, and X-ray/CCDC provenance for 3ab.

regions.region: lower-right beginning of N-phenyl nitrone/Scheme 2-1 discussion
regions.finding: Linked the standard-condition 1m+2a experiment to Scheme 2-1 on page 5: product 4 is obtained in 22% with qualitative 9-fluorenone and indole by-products.

unresolved: Table 2/3 captions give a 3–6 h range rather than exact row times and omit atmosphere, workup, purification, and masses.
Compact scope structures remain source-labeled where safe stereochemical encoding was uncertain.
By-product quantities for the 1m experiment are not reported.

regions.region: left-column Scheme 2 experiments 1-4 and control-study prose
regions.finding: Recorded five distinct current-paper experiments: 1m→4, D2O labeling, compound-5 intermediate test, and separate C5 and C6 catalyst controls. Product, recovery, decomposition, deuterium incorporation, and catalyst-specific yields remain separate outcomes.
Classified A-D, competing compound 5, and the cyclization pathway as one proposed mechanism. Proposed intermediates were not treated as isolated preparations.
Linked the distinct gram-scale 3aa preparation and three independent 3aa transformations to the Scheme 4 arrows on page 6. Only facts printed in the covered pages were used.

unresolved: Scheme 2 controls omit several absolute charges, solvent volumes, times, workups, masses, recovery/conversion values, and detection limits.
Scheme 3 intermediates are proposed and unquantified.
Scheme 4 arrows omit most reagent amounts and times.

regions.finding: Recorded 1a 1.0 g/4 mmol, C1 50 mol%, DMF/80 °C, and 3aa 0.89 g/65% as an independent scale-up; unprinted 2a charge and time remain missing.

Recorded three separate arrows: NaBH4/MeOH room-temperature reduction to 6 (61%, dr >20:1), DBU/Et2O cyclopropenone annulation to 7 (55%, dr 1.8:1), and benzene-1,2-diamine/EtOH reflux condensation to 8 (35%). Missing amounts/times were not inferred.
Narrative summary and administrative text only; no new experiment or result beyond Scheme 4 is introduced.
Bibliography/prior-literature citations only. External cited experiments were not imported as records of this article.

unresolved: Scale-up 2a charge/solvent volume/time and derivatization scales, reagent amounts, times, workups, masses, and yield/selectivity bases are not reported.
Referenced external experiments were not re-extracted as current-paper records.
